_notes: 638 keys had no Hindi (cur = null); all are translated here. Agency strings are imperative and dense; University strings are formal.
Consultation is 'काउंसलिंग' everywhere (the single stray 'परामर्श' in agency:v27.stage.CONSULT is aligned), matching the marketing/common patch.
'Reply owed' / 'Replies owed' is 'जवाब बाक़ी' / 'बाक़ी जवाब' across inbox, students and today (inbox.needsReplyShort was a different wording for the same concept).
'Overdue' in console chips and counts is 'ओवरड्यू', the word Indian operations staff use; the longer 'समय-सीमा निकल गई' stays where the English is a full sentence (v27.stage.overdue).
'Waiting on X' follows the existing 'छात्र का इंतज़ार' pattern: 'विश्वविद्यालय का इंतज़ार', 'हमारा इंतज़ार', 'दूतावास या किसी और पक्ष का इंतज़ार'.

Admission letter is 'एडमिशन लेटर' ('प्रवेश पत्र'/'प्रवेश प्रमाणपत्र' read as an exam admit card in India); the official 표준입학허가서 is 'स्टैंडर्ड एडमिशन लेटर' in agency:ws.noVisaText and university:decision.certificateInfo. Apostille = एपोस्टिल, consular legalization = कॉन्सुलर लीगलाइज़ेशन, 'Notarization & legalization' = नोटरी और लीगलाइज़ेशन (university:documents.legalization said 'कांसुलर सत्यापन', which is both the wrong concept and too narrow).
agency:today.afternoon: Hindi has no natural 'good afternoon'; rendered as 'नमस्ते, {{name}}' (morning/evening keep सुप्रभात / शुभ संध्या).
Statistical 'population' (university:metric.population, v25.in.submittedSub) is 'आधार समूह', not 'जनसंख्या' (which means the population of a country).

agency:ws.targetEntry said 'target admission date' (लक्षित प्रवेश तारीख़); English is 'Planned arrival date' — corrected. university:v28.pipe.label/title said 'pipeline and outcomes, open Analytics'; English is 'Outcomes to date; see Insights' — corrected. agency:v23.work.submissionsNeed_other said 'the team is needed for N submissions'; corrected to 'N applications awaiting team submission'.
university:v28.pipe.step.OFFERED/ACCEPTED are written from the university's side ('ऑफ़र दिया' / 'ऑफ़र स्वीकार'); the earlier 'ऑफ़र मिला' was the student's perspective.
agency:savedViews.namePh example now uses 'स्प्रिंग 2027' to match common:term.SPRING.
